select om.sys_id , om.link_sys_id, ti.table_num , og.order_num , case when exists ( select 1 from order_detail od2 where od2.link_sys_id = om.sys_id and od2.payment_yn = 'N' ) then 'N' else 'Y' end as payment_status , om.order_status , null as order_status_nm , 0 as total_price , om.insert_datetime as order_start_datetime from order_detail od left join order_group og on og.sys_id = od.link_sys_id3 left join order_master om on om.sys_id = od.link_sys_id left join table_info ti on ti.sys_id = om.link_sys_id and ti.use_yn = 'Y' and ti.delete_yn = 'N' where 1=1
and (ti.table_num like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') or og.order_num like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
and om.order_status = #{orderStatus}
and om.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and om.insert_datetime::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date group by om.sys_id, om.link_sys_id, ti.table_num, og.order_num, om.order_status, om.insert_datetime

select od.sys_id , od.link_sys_id as master_sys_id , smd.menu_name , smd.menu_price * od.qty as menu_price , null as menu_option , od.insert_datetime as order_datetime from order_detail od left join store_menu_detail smd on smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 where 1=1 and od.link_sys_id in
#{id}

select odo.link_sys_id as master_sys_id, concat(smod.menu_option_name, smod.menu_option_price) as menu_option from order_detail_option odo left join store_menu_option_detail smod on smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 where 1=1 and smod.sys_id in
#{id}
